title: Rice Taiwanese Association
content_html:
The Rice Taiwanese Association (RTA) is a non-partisan cultural and social organization at Rice University dedicated to celebrating and sharing Taiwanese culture and heritage with the broader campus community. It is recognized by Rice’s Student Center and Office of Multicultural Affairs, and holds membership in the Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Students Association (ITASA). Its founding year is not documented in available first-party sources.

RTA sponsors a range of cultural programming open to all Rice students, including study breaks themed around Taiwanese food and traditions — such as mahjong nights, dumpling-making, brush-painting seminars, shaved ice, mooncakes, and noodles — as well as restaurant trips to Houston’s Chinatown. Members also form smaller units called Families, each with their own budget for informal outings including movie nights, gaming sessions, boba runs, and family dinners. One long-running internal tradition is Iron Chef, an annual cooking competition the organization has held for over ten years. The organization’s signature campus-wide event is the Night Market, held each spring semester on the Rice campus.

RTA maintains an active social media presence through Instagram (@ricetaiwanese) and a Facebook page, and lists a Carrd landing page (ricetaiwanese.carrd.co) alongside its official Rice-hosted website. Its connection to the national ITASA network reflects a broader engagement with Taiwanese American student communities across the United States.
